CustomField.description: ssot__FlowElementRunId__c claimed from Data Cloud for this recipient ("<GUID>#<SendElementName>"). Flow-triggered sends return no per-recipient message id, so engagement is correlated by claiming the earliest unclaimed SEND_STATUS row for the individual and keying every later open/click/bounce off this value.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Data Cloud flow run id used to match engagement to this recipient.
CustomField.label: Flow Run Id
